verdict.rationale: The Mesh API documents a per-customer endpoint to set the monitoring configuration, backed by a dedicated "Monitor and unmonitor customers" permission. A companion endpoint returns each customer's monitor status, so a compliance officer can turn ongoing screening on or off for specific customers and verify the result. Ongoing monitoring alerts then flow into case management. Missing for 10: evidence of an enable/disable control in the web application rather than API only, bulk or multi-customer selection (endpoints are single-customer), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
